about: The fixture ticket, drafted and waiting in Not Started, goes through the triage graph: the scripts pass it, the sign-off step's session (the stand-in) writes its role's example result, and the run ends with the ticket moved to Ready. As on the laptop, the Jira email is only in state/jira-email (JP-171) and claude only in ~/.local/bin, which a job's PATH lacks: the entry gate must admit the run and Agent Manager must find claude.

checks.check: a run started for the ticket
the run ended at its end state
the fake Jira shows the ticket in the status the graph sets
every role step has one Agent Manager session
the ticket's sessions follow its status: a live one sits in the group for the ticket's status, a finished one is killed and filed in completed-steps (or archived)
every Jira call carried the credentials found the laptop's way (email only in state/jira-email)
the entry gate admitted the run
Agent Manager found claude in ~/.local/bin under a job's PATH (no JOSH360_CLAUDE_BIN)
